transcribedBy: Claude Code, by hand from the extracted source, 2026-10-14
notes: The compartments are shares of the population: the stated starting values sum to 0.825.
Time is in years: the model is fitted to 30 years of annual data, 1990-2019. No units are given.
Two death rates differ only in their letter: Latin v, on treatment, and Greek nu, off treatment.
eta and theta are proportions, without units, though the table calls eta a rate.
rho's printed range, 0.009-0.0011, does not hold its value, 0.053; the value is taken as printed.
The force of infection, lambda = beta1 I + beta2 C + beta3 Cq, is written out in each rate.
